This dashboard reads **deduplicated** cost data from the `azure_billing.usage_latest` and `azure_billing.forecast_latest` transform aliases, not from the raw `metrics-azure.billing-*` data stream.

The Azure billing metricset re-fetches the most recent days on every run, so the raw data stream holds several copies of the same cost row. Two Elasticsearch transforms shipped with this integration keep, for every day, only the rows of the most recent fetch, which matters because Azure keeps revising costs for about 72 hours. The raw data stream is unchanged and remains the system of record.

Every cost is broken down by __currency__, so amounts in different currencies are never added together.

> The `logs-azure_billing.usage-*` and `logs-azure_billing.latest_forecast-*` transforms must be running for these panels to show data.
